full_judgment: 3. It has also been stated in the writ petition that Jamshed Khan migrated from India in 1950 and since then he was all along a Bangladesh citizen and his whereabouts were not unknown at any point of time, Jamshed Khan died on 6-10-86 and was buried in the graveyard of Section 10/A, Mirpur, Dhaka and the secretary of the said graveyard committee issued a certificate to that effect. That the Assistant Commissioner Settlement of the Ministry of Housing and Public Works by his Memo No. MH 301/61/9747 Kasha dated 21-8-1995 requested the Administrative Officer, Mirpur Housing Estate to enquire into the present position of the property in question and accordingly, an enquiry was held by the administrative officer and an inspector of Mirpur Housing Estate who submitted their enquiry report to the Assistant Commissioner, Housing and Public Works Ministry stating that the property in question was leased out to Jamshed Khan who paid the entire consideration money and Jamshed Khan while was in possession of the said property sold the same to this petitioner by a registered kabala dated 31-5-80. Further case of the petitioner is, that while was in possession of the property in question he went to Kuwait on 5-9-83 getting a job there and on 25-11-90 he came back from Kuwait. Since after his coming back from Kuwait the petitioner had been trying to get his name mutated in respect of the property in question. That the respondents, specially the Assistant Commissioner Ministry of Housing and Public Works and the Administrative Officer, Mirpur Housing Estate assured the petitioner that there was nothing to be worried, that he would get his name mutated in due time. But in the meantime the petitioner fell ill and had to remain under treatment for a long period and being cured, when he contacted the Assistant Commissioner, Housing and Public Works Ministry on 3-6-2003 he was informed for the first time that the property in question had been enlisted as abandoned property and thereafter the petitioner contacted his lawyer and on his advice he filed this writ petition. That the property in question was never abandoned property as the original allotted of this property was all along in possession of this property till the date of transfer of the same to the petitioner. That the enlistment of the property in question as abandoned property has been illegal.
